author: RT1912
quote: I thought there would be several improvements to the game compared to the demo (which was terribly bad), but the final game is exactly the same. The music is bad, the graphics are bad, the art style is in very poor taste, the characters are loathsome, and the level design looks like it was done by a game design student learning how to place elements on a map (they're not fun maps). But the real problem with this game is its core gameplay, its rules. The only positive aspect is some of the sound effects. In short, I think it's a Destiny 2 DLC that was canceled because it was boring, and to avoid tarnishing Destiny 2's image, they decided to slap a skin on it and sell it as a separate game.
